Name: UPTIME
Label: Uptime
Description: Elapsed seconds from device startup

Name: REGMAP_VERSION
Label: Register map version
Description:
Version of register map in format xxxyyy.
Xxx - major version of register map.
Yyy - minor version of register map.
Major version defines compatibility of different register maps. If major version of register map changes, the values previously stored in the flash memory are discarded and factory values are used

Name: STATUS
Label: Status register
Description:
Binary map of different status flags
Meaning of respective bits: 
[0] - Generic error - Error in the device.
[1] - Testing mode - Testing mode is enabled.
[2] - Calibrated successfully - Calibration data read successfully.
[3] - Modbus timeout - No modbus communication for timeout period.
[16] - Configuration flash error - Error when working with configuration memory.
[17] - Reset by IWDG - Last reset was caused by Independent watchdog.

Name: COMMAND
Label: Command
Description:
Following commands are supported:
Value 9901 - Reset
Value 8801 - Factory reset
Value 7701 - Testing mode
Value 66xx - Invoke error
Value 5501 - Invoke watchdog reset

Name: TEST
Label: Testing register
Description: Generic system testing register

Name: IO_INPUT
Label: Input signals
Description:
Set of input signals. 
Bits 0-4 - Modbus address offset
Bits 5-8 - Bootstrap
Bit 9 - Pushbutton

Name: SERIAL_NUMBER
Label: Serial number
Description:
Serial number of product with common device ID in format xxyyzzzz.
Xx - year of production
Yy - month of production
zzzz - serial incremental number of the product

Name: DEVICE_ID
Label: Product number
Description: Unique device ID

Name: HW_REVISION
Label: Hardware version
Description:
Hardware revision of the device defined as xxxyyy:
xxx - major revision (letter)
yyy - minor revision (number)

Name: BOOT_REVISION
Label: Bootloader version
Description:
Firmware revision of the bootloader as number xxxyyy:
xxx - major version of bootloader
yyy - minor version of bootloader

Name: REVISION
Label: Firmware revision
Description: Firmware revision of the current application image as an incremental number. See list of FW revision or release notes for respective features.

Name: ASSEMBLY_INFO
Label: Assembly date
Description:
Assembly information of the current application in format xxxxyyzz:
xxxx - year of FW build
yy - month of FW build
zz - day of FW build

Name: MB_BAUD_RATE
Label: Modbus baud rate
Description:
Modbus RTU serial port baud rate
Allowed values: 
9600 - 9600 baud/s.
19200 - 19200 baud/s.
38400 - 38400 baud/s.
57600 - 57600 baud/s.
115200 - 115200 baud/s.

Name: MB_PARITY
Label: Modbus parity
Description:
Modbus RTU serial port parity
Allowed values: 
NONE - NONE parity.
EVEN - EVEN parity.
ODD - ODD parity.

Name: MB_STOP_BITS
Label: Modbus stop bits
Description:
Modbus RTU serial port - number of stop bits
Allowed values: 
1 stop bit - 1 stop bit.
2 stop bits - 2 stop bits.

Name: MB_ADDRESS
Label: Modbus slave address
Description: Modbus RTU serial port slave address

Name: MB_APPLY
Label: Apply modbus parameters
Description:
Apply new modbus communication parameters.
Value 1 - Apply new settings

Name: MB_TIMEOUT
Label: Modbus timeout
Description:
Longer silent period implies connection lost.
Zero value disables timeout indication.

Name: MODE
Label: Emulation mode
Description:
Mode of RTD emulation.
Allowed values: 
Direct resistance - Set resistance is directly applied to RTD ports.
NTC thermistor - Set temperature is used for NTC resistance computation.
Platinum RTD - Set temperature is used for PT1000 resistance computation.

Name: CHANNEL_SELECT
Label: RTD channel selection
Description: RTD channel selection (0 = main board, 1-4 = 1. expansion board, 5-8 = 2. expansion board, )

Name: NTC_BETA
Label: NTC beta
Description: NTC beta coefficient for computation

Name: NTC_STOCK_RES
Label: NTC stock resistance
Description: NTC stock resistance at 25 C (10000 for common 10k NTC)

Name: PT_STOCK_RES
Label: Platinum stock resistance
Description:
Platinum stock resistance at 0 C
Value 100 - PT100
Value 500 - PT500
Value 1000 - PT1000

Name: RESISTANCE
Label: Set resistance
Description: Resistance that should be set at RTD port

Name: TEMPERATURE
Label: Temperature
Description: Temperature that should be set at RTD port

Name: SLEWRATE_MODE
Label: Temp slew rate mode
Description:
Temperature slew rate MODE 
Allowed values: 
Slew rate off - Temperature slew rate mode ON.
Slew rate on - Temperature slew rate mode OFF.

Name: SLEWRATE
Label: Temperature slew rate
Description: Temperature slew rate in C/s

Name: SLEWRATE_MAX
Label: Max temperature in SR mode
Description: Set maximum of temperature range in SR mode

Name: SLEWRATE_MIN
Label: Min temperature in SR mode
Description: Set minimum of temperature range in SR mode

Name: CHANNEL_MODE
Label: Channel temperature mode
Description:
How the temperatures reach the channels (NTC and PT modes):
Value 0 - selected channel: RTD_TEMPERATURE goes to the channel of RTD_CHANNEL_SELECT, one channel at a time
Value 1 - per channel: every channel 0-8 follows its own RTD_TEMPERATURE_CHx, all at once
Slew rate and direct resistance mode work on the channel of RTD_CHANNEL_SELECT in both modes
Allowed values: 
Selected channel - RTD_TEMPERATURE goes to the channel of RTD_CHANNEL_SELECT.
Per channel - Every channel follows its own RTD_TEMPERATURE_CHx.

Name: TEMPERATURE_CH0
Label: Temperature channel 0
Description: Temperature of channel 0 (main board) in the per channel mode (RTD_CHANNEL_MODE = 1)

Name: TEMPERATURE_CH1
Label: Temperature channel 1
Description: Temperature of channel 1 (1. expansion board, channel 1) in the per channel mode (RTD_CHANNEL_MODE = 1)

Name: TEMPERATURE_CH2
Label: Temperature channel 2
Description: Temperature of channel 2 (1. expansion board, channel 2) in the per channel mode (RTD_CHANNEL_MODE = 1)

Name: TEMPERATURE_CH3
Label: Temperature channel 3
Description: Temperature of channel 3 (1. expansion board, channel 3) in the per channel mode (RTD_CHANNEL_MODE = 1)

Name: TEMPERATURE_CH4
Label: Temperature channel 4
Description: Temperature of channel 4 (1. expansion board, channel 4) in the per channel mode (RTD_CHANNEL_MODE = 1)

Name: TEMPERATURE_CH5
Label: Temperature channel 5
Description: Temperature of channel 5 (2. expansion board, channel 1) in the per channel mode (RTD_CHANNEL_MODE = 1)

Name: TEMPERATURE_CH6
Label: Temperature channel 6
Description: Temperature of channel 6 (2. expansion board, channel 2) in the per channel mode (RTD_CHANNEL_MODE = 1)

Name: TEMPERATURE_CH7
Label: Temperature channel 7
Description: Temperature of channel 7 (2. expansion board, channel 3) in the per channel mode (RTD_CHANNEL_MODE = 1)

Name: TEMPERATURE_CH8
Label: Temperature channel 8
Description: Temperature of channel 8 (2. expansion board, channel 4) in the per channel mode (RTD_CHANNEL_MODE = 1)

Name: WRITES_CONF
Label: Configuration writes
Description: Number of writes into internal configuration flash memory (size 4kB, entry 128 B, total endurance 10000 * 4096 / 128 = 320000)
